exploratory_disclosure: Before this PREREG was written the lane owner read the SAMPLES README, the verifier's problem list, and the local raw mirror. That reading already showed: the 12 CUA agent.logs contain 0 completed tool calls and 27 tool errors, all from tool 'tool_call' (23 'tool_call requires calls', 3 unknown tool names, 1 'tool_call cannot invoke tool_search'); 0 lines matching 'approv'; GUI state before == after in 12/12; the observer has 27 pre_tool_call and 27 post_tool_call rows in those 12 sessions; the 5 cua_button_present replies are all 'No'; the decider_2b turn-lane warm series has a 180,127 ms entry at warm index 3; t096 ended with turn_exit_reason pending_tool_result; the PREREG hermes hash shares only its first 10 hex digits with the real commit. The verifier's '23 tool errors' therefore matches only the largest error class; this PREREG fixes in advance how the packet will report it (C2).

C1_cua_attribution.inputs: raw/runs/<12 CUA runs>/agent.log and errors.log (sanitized copies of the private-home logs), dataset/events.jsonl, raw/runs/<run>/gui-state, raw/runs/<run>/argv, raw/runs/<run>/stdout
C1_cua_attribution.claim_if_all_hold: Every CUA failure is a REAL failure at the tool_call bridge: no CUA run reached computer_use or cua-driver, and the approval gate was never exercised.
criteria: every tool error line names tool 'tool_call'
0 lines matching /approv|fail.clos/i in agent.log, errors.log, stdout
0 computer_use dispatch lines (tool_executor lines naming computer_use)
per session: agent.log tool-line count == observer pre_tool_call count == post_tool_call count
C1_cua_attribution.if_any_fails: The erratum states what the logs show instead; no attribution claim beyond the data.

checks.C2_count_reporting: Report the total number of tool errors and the breakdown by error class exactly as the logs show, and state the reconciliation with the verifier's figure of 23.
checks.C3_verify_and_tamper: verify_artifacts.py (SAMPLES packet) must print RESULT PASS after the edits. Tamper copies must each print RESULT FAIL: (a) one oracle verdict flipped; (b) one README evaluation-table cell changed; (c) one CUA agent.log error line rewritten as a completed call; (d) one MANIFEST count changed.
checks.C4_table_reproducibility: Every results table in the SAMPLES README is regenerated byte-exact from committed raw files by harness/make_tables.py, and summary.json is regenerated byte-exact by harness/make_summary.py; verify_artifacts.py fails on any difference.
checks.C5_manifest_reproducibility: dataset/MANIFEST.json files, content_sha256 and counts are recomputed from dataset/ files; MANIFEST identities equal provenance identities; the README's dataset hash equals MANIFEST content_sha256.
checks.C6_numbers_kept: All metric numbers in the SAMPLES evaluation tables stay as they are where the raw data support them. Expected text changes only: CUA attribution, BLOCKED row, claim boundary, exit-reason sentence (7 + 1), wall-time label, E1 wording, decider warm max/mean disclosure, one-hot nit, unit log, harness-files timing, failopen.log duplicate lines.
checks.C7_unit_log: Run tests/lab at hermes 5d01f60897373e67 under hostless with private HOME/HERMES_HOME and a dead egress proxy; record the result whatever it is (the original claim was 25 passed, 2 skipped; 13/13 on the 3 shadow files with z0int on PYTHONPATH).
